scope: Production relay and FeedbackStore in real local workerd; test-only DO subclass injects storage time/failure and inspects stored records. Fake phone. No production deployment or physical device.

checks.name: disabled and malformed administrator configuration do not expose feedback capability or routes
authentication roles, pending denial and unknown body fields never consume report write quota
creation returns only receipt; idempotency, same-scope deduplication and private details persist
pagination cursors bind authorization domain and filters; lists never include body
supplements and administrator responses are private, bounded and owner-readable
deletion erases body and indexes; idempotent retries cannot resurrect original content
revocation denies all old AI feedback operations while owner retains management across new claim
anonymous receipts support lost-response retry but cannot enumerate or cross-authorize
origin, JSON size, malformed text and disallowed methods give static errors without input reflection
feedback rate/failure does not alter phone sequence or command admission
report content, tombstones and hashed receipts survive workerd restart
retention deletes actual stored content on read and alarm, removes private receipt hashes and renews cleanup
bounded claim capacity includes deletion tombstones and cannot be bypassed by retrying deletes
alarm cleanup drains multiple bounded batches without dropping its next wakeup
feedback implementation and runtime logs never emit submitted bodies or credentials
